fusions.name: Rake the Row
fusions.desc: Rakes 5 curved cuts forward in a spread out to 3 tiles, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Weight Behind the Curve
fusions.desc: Strikes for 32 damage, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Stand Tall
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lean Winter
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you heal for 30% of all damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
